rules: Read your last sent text aloud, or take 1 sip. Skip private messages.

title: Nicetitties
rules: Say something nice about the person to your right.

title: Work it
rules: Do a runway walk for the table.

title: ABC's
rules: Say the alphabet backward. Every mistake earns 1 sip, up to 2.

title: Tin Hat Society
rules: Share one conspiracy theory you actually believe, or one you invented.

title: Happy Holidays
rules: Invent a fake holiday in 10 seconds. Miss the deadline: take 1 sip.

title: Stare down
rules: Challenge someone to a staring contest. Loser takes 1 sip.

title: Spelling Contest
rules: The person on your left gives you a word to spell. Wrong? You sip. Right? They sip.

title: Knickers
rules: Guess the underwear color of the person to your right, if they opt in. Miss: 1 sip.

title: Weatherman
rules: Give a dramatic weather forecast for tonight’s vibes.

title: Dare
rules: Balance an empty cup on your head for 10 seconds, or take 1 sip.

title: Opinions
rules: Give your most Joe-or-Becca opinion. The table guesses whose it is.

title: Debate
rules: Pick a silly topic. Each side gets 10 seconds to argue. The table votes for a winner.

title: Caveman
rules: Until your next turn, speak only in grunts. Slip: take 1 sip.

title: Mr Freeze
rules: Touch someone’s shoulder with permission. They freeze until you let go.

title: Wench
rules: You are the drink wench until your next turn. Offer refills when asked.

title: Potty Mouth
rules: No swearing until the next card. Slip: take 1 sip.

title: Rawr XD
rules: Keep T-Rex arms until your next turn. Forget: take 1 sip.

title: This Sucks
rules: Buffalo switches hands until the next card. Wrong hand: 1 sip.

title: Pokemon
rules: Speak only your first name until your next turn. Slip: 1 sip.

title: Abra like a Slut
rules: Reverse the turn order after this card.

title: Goof Dog
rules: Keep your eyes wide open until your next turn. Blink freely when needed.

title: No Hands
rules: Until your next turn, keep your hands off your cup. You may skip the rule.

title: No Beer
rules: Until the next card, first to say “beer” takes 1 sip.

title: Banana Peel
rules: Until your next turn, mime peeling your drink like a banana before each sip.

title: A toast to the VIP
rules: Toast the VIP by name. The VIP takes 1 sip; everyone joins them.

title: Choose a sidekick
rules: The VIP picks a sidekick until the next card is revealed. They both take one sip now.

title: The VIP tax
rules: The VIP takes 1 sip and names a privilege they'd trade away tonight.

title: One Year Older
rules: The VIP gives 1 sip to someone younger, or takes 1 themselves.

title: It’s Gotta Go
rules: The VIP takes 1 sip, then chooses someone to join them.

title: Instant fan club
rules: Clockwise, say why you're glad the VIP is here. Then the VIP takes 1 sip.

title: Standing ovation
rules: Give the VIP a standing ovation. Last to stand takes 1 sip; so does the VIP.

title: Outstanding favors
rules: Anyone who owes the VIP a favor takes 1 sip. The VIP takes 1 too.

title: Your Big Night
rules: Everyone says something nice about the VIP. Then everyone takes 1 sip.

title: A gift for the VIP
rules: Clockwise, name gifts for the VIP. No repeats. First to repeat or pass takes 1 sip.

title: Class superlatives
rules: Clockwise, name awards for the VIP. No repeats. First to repeat or pass takes 1 sip.

title: The loving roast
rules: Clockwise, give the VIP a gentle roast. The VIP picks a favorite and takes 1 sip.

title: A title for the VIP
rules: Give the VIP a silly title. They take 1 sip and use it next time they speak.

title: Fast as Fuck Boi
rules: The VIP picks someone to say the alphabet in one minute. Miss a letter: take 1 sip.

title: Your Excellency
rules: Call the VIP Your Excellency until the next card. Forget and take 1 sip.

title: Never drink alone
rules: Until the next card, the VIP picks someone to join each sip they take.
